name: Pec Deck Fly
steps: Adjust the seat so your upper arms are near shoulder height, then sit against the backrest with your feet flat.
Rest bent forearms on the pads or grasp the handles with elbows slightly bent, depending on the machine.
Squeeze your chest muscles to sweep both arms smoothly forward in a wide arc until the handles nearly meet in front of your sternum.
Return the arms slowly back to a comfortable chest stretch without letting the weight stack bang.
tips: Keep your shoulder blades pinned back against the backrest instead of rounding your shoulders forward at peak contraction.
Avoid setting the handles so far back that the front of your shoulders feels strained.
